d: Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) claims to have brought down three US drones near the strategically vital Strait of Hormuz, escalating tensions between Tehran and Washington. According to the IRGC, one MQ-9 Reaper drone was intercepted using a newly developed air defence network, while two MQM-170 Outlaw reconnaissance drones were seized through electronic warfare systems. The claims come amid heightened military friction in the region, raising fresh questions about Iran’s evolving air defence capabilities and its ability to challenge American military operations.
